subject: MSA & Order Form: support SLO redlines — blackout handling proposal
messages:
From: Elena Morales <procurement@stratalabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Desai <ops@stratalabs.com>, Priya Reddy <legal@stratalabs.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA / Order Form — support SLO redlines and blackout window proposals

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the draft MSA and Order Form. We ran the SLA language by our engineering and procurement teams and have a few material asks before legal will sign off. Attached is a PDF with our proposed redlines (StrataLabs_SLA_redline_v1.pdf). High level: 

- Availability target: we need explicit regional blackout tolerances for scheduled infra maintenance. For planned datacenter maintenance that falls within a published blackout window, we propose 99.95% (monthly) for the impacted region, not 99.99%.
- Service credits: cap the credit for scheduled maintenance events at 25% of the impacted month’s subscription, and allow cumulative annual cap of 3x monthly fees.
- Response times: P1 1 hour, P2 4 hours — this is non-negotiable per our ops SLA.
- Emergency patching: we need a carveout allowing for urgent security patches with a 2-hour warning window but no credits if the patch is declared an emergency by StrataLabs.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept the regional blackout tolerance and the capped credit structure? If not, please propose alternate language — our legal team (Priya) would like track-changed Word if you have it.

We’d also like to schedule a short MTG with your ops lead to walk through the maintenance calendar constraints (Samir copied). Ideally this week or early next.

Thanks,

Elena Morales
Head of Procurement | StrataLabs
procurement@stratalabs.com
Attachment: StrataLabs_SLA_redline_v1.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <procurement@stratalabs.com>
Cc: Samir Desai <ops@stratalabs.com>, Priya Reddy <legal@stratalabs.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form — support SLO redlines and blackout window proposals

Elena — thanks for the clear redlines and the PDF — much appreciated. Quick response from our side after an initial ops/legal review: 

- Regional blackout tolerance: Redwood is open to a region-limited scheduled maintenance SLA of 99.95% for predefined blackout windows (we’ll need windows to be pre-notified and published 30 days in advance).
- Service credits: we can sign to a capped credit per incident set to 25% of the impacted month for scheduled maintenance, but we need to retain an annual cap at 2x monthly fees rather than 3x given our existing platform economics.
- Response times: P1 1 hour is acceptable; P2 4 hours is borderline for some configurations. Ops (Jonas copied) will confirm whether we can guarantee P2 at 4 hours for dedicated and hosted tiers. We can definitely guarantee it for Dedicated customers, may need to qualify for Hosted.
- Emergency patching carveout: we accept an emergency carveout but request that emergency conditions be mutually agreed in writing (post-incident notice acceptable).

I’ve attached a short redline response (redwood_support_response_redlines.docx) that shows our suggested compromises — tracks the credit cap down to 2x annual and includes language for notification and calendar publication.

Next steps: 
- Legal to legal: Kimberly, can you take Priya’s and our redlines and propose track-changes for the MSA?
- Ops sync: Jonas, can we confirm by tomorrow whether P2=4h is viable on Hosted? If not, propose tiered response language.
- Joint call: Elena — available Fri 10:00 PT for a quick 30-min call to resolve the credits vs cap? If that doesn’t work, we can do Monday.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Attachment: redwood_support_response_redlines.docx

Date: Sat, 17 Mar 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form — support SLO redlines and blackout window proposals

Marissa — thanks for the prompt reply and the Word file. Forwarding a few counter suggestions from our counsel after an internal review. Please see the attached tracked changes (StrataLabs_SLA_countertrack.docx).

On Thu, Mar 15, 2028 at 1:45 PM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Elena — thanks for the clear redlines and the PDF — much appreciated. Quick response from our side after an initial ops/legal review: 
> 
> - Regional blackout tolerance: Redwood is open to a region-limited scheduled maintenance SLA of 99.95% for predefined blackout windows (we’ll need windows to be pre-notified and published 30 days in advance).
> - Service credits: we can sign to a capped credit per incident set to 25% of the impacted month for scheduled maintenance, but we need to retain an annual cap at 2x monthly fees rather than 3x given our existing platform economics.
> - Response times: P1 1 hour is acceptable; P2 4 hours is borderline for some configurations. Ops (Jonas copied) will confirm whether we can guarantee P2 at 4 hours for Hosted.
> - Emergency patching carveout: we accept an emergency carveout but request that emergency conditions be mutually agreed in writing (post-incident notice acceptable).

We have two specific legal asks: 
1) Limit the definition of "scheduled maintenance" to events that are published at least 30 days in advance and that do not include rolling hardware updates that extend beyond a single calendar day without separate notice.
2) For emergency patches: we cannot accept language that entirely eliminates credits for security patches unless you agree to a maximum of 10% credit for emergency maintenance that exceeds the published emergency window.

Additionally, our counsel requests a firm cap on cumulative credits per 12-month period (we proposed 3x monthly fees in our redline). If Redwood requires a lower cap, please provide the business rationale for 2x so our legal team can evaluate.

Please loop in your legal lead so we can aim to exchange final tracked versions by Wed 3/22.

Regards,

Priya Reddy
Senior Counsel | StrataLabs
legal@stratalabs.com
Attachment: StrataLabs_SLA_countertrack.docx

Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form — support SLO redlines and blackout window proposals

Thanks Priya — appreciate the detailed countertrack. Looping in our legal lead Laura Bennett and ops (Jonas) to finalize. Short notes from our side: 

- On the annual cap: Redwood’s standard commercial math uses 2x monthly fees as the upper bound to preserve service economics across our multi-tenant clusters; I’ll ask Laura to include a short rationale in her comments so your counsel has context.
- On emergency patch credit: we can accept a small credit (up to 10%) for emergency maintenance that exceeds the emergency window, provided that the emergency is confirmed by Redwood ops and documented within 72 hours.
- On P2 response: Jonas — can you confirm earliest tomorrow whether we can guarantee P2=4h for Hosted or whether we should propose tiered SLOs (Dedicated vs Hosted)?

Proposed immediate next steps: Laura and Kimberly will produce a single consolidated redline from the two Word files and circulate by end of day Wed 2028-03-22. Marissa to schedule a 30-min ops/legal call for Thu 2028-03-23 at 10:00 AM PT (please confirm availability).

Marissa Cole
